close_action.docs:
**[Action](https://esphome.io/automations/actions#all-actions)**: The action that should be performed when the remote requests the cover to be closed.

*See also: [Endstop Cover](https://esphome.io/components/cover/endstop#configuration-variables)*

close_duration.docs:
**[Time](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#time)**: The amount of time it takes the cover to close from the fully-open state.

*See also: [Endstop Cover](https://esphome.io/components/cover/endstop#configuration-variables)*

close_endstop.docs:
**[ID](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#id)**: The ID of the [Binary Sensor](https://esphome.io/components/binary_sensor#config-binary_sensor) that turns on when the closed position is reached.

*See also: [Endstop Cover](https://esphome.io/components/cover/endstop#configuration-variables)*

max_duration.docs:
**[Time](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#time)**: The maximum duration the cover should be opening or closing. Useful for protecting from dysfunctional endstops.

*See also: [Endstop Cover](https://esphome.io/components/cover/endstop#configuration-variables)*

open_action.docs:
**[Action](https://esphome.io/automations/actions#all-actions)**: The action that should be performed when the remote requests the cover to be opened.

*See also: [Endstop Cover](https://esphome.io/components/cover/endstop#configuration-variables)*

open_duration.docs:
**[Time](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#time)**: The amount of time it takes the cover to open up from the fully-closed state.

*See also: [Endstop Cover](https://esphome.io/components/cover/endstop#configuration-variables)*

open_endstop.docs:
**[ID](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#id)**: The ID of the [Binary Sensor](https://esphome.io/components/binary_sensor#config-binary_sensor) that turns on when the open position is reached.

*See also: [Endstop Cover](https://esphome.io/components/cover/endstop#configuration-variables)*

stop_action.docs:
**[Action](https://esphome.io/automations/actions#all-actions)**: The action that should be performed when the remote requests the cover to stop or an endstop is reached.

*See also: [Endstop Cover](https://esphome.io/components/cover/endstop#configuration-variables)*
